title: 伊泽瑞尔·远行石桥
description: 金发伊泽瑞尔在宽石桥上停步，护目镜、颊纹与金色护手清楚，完整旅行装被强烈斜光映出层次。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Ezreal is a blond young adult explorer with blue eyes, tousled hair, round goggles on his head, and recognizable blue cheek markings. Preserve his agile human proportions and blue-brown travel outfit through a fully covering jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and sturdy boots. His ornate golden magical gauntlet remains attached to one forearm but quiet and unlit, without a projectile or aimed gesture.
art_direction.scene: Show him pausing midway across a broad ancient stone bridge, one hand resting near his travel bag and the gauntleted arm lowered naturally. A distant monumental ruin rises beyond a calm valley. Hard morning light crosses the face and coarse wax-crayon clothing planes, while simple receding parapets create clear perspective and an adventurous mood without running, falling, or combat.
art_direction.palette: sunlit blond, cobalt, leather brown, pale sandstone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
